mapper.select: SELECT c.iso_code AS country_code, cs.code AS subdivision_code, pt.code AS product_type_code, tr.rate FROM tax_rate tr JOIN country c ON c.country_id = tr.country_id LEFT JOIN country_subdivision cs ON cs.country_id = tr.country_id AND cs.country_subdivision_id = tr.country_subdivision_id LEFT JOIN product_type pt ON pt.product_type_id = tr.product_type_id
